t: The $(item)Solar Compressor/$ generates $(l:base_concepts/pressure)compressed air/$ and $(l:base_concepts/heat)heat/$ from $(thing)sunlight/$. To function, it requires a clear view of direct sunlight. This means it is unable to function inside, during the night, or during storms.
$(item)太阳能压缩机/$通过$(thing)阳光/$产生$(l:base_concepts/pressure)压缩空气/$和$(l:base_concepts/heat)热量/$。要正常工作，它需要能够直接照射到阳光。这意味着它无法在室内、夜晚或暴风雨期间工作。
合成一个$(item)太阳能压缩机/$。

While the $(item)Solar Compressor/$ generates compressed air, it also generates heat proportional to how much compressed air is generated. Proper heat management is necessary to reach the full potential of the $(item)Solar Compressor/$: too little heat and the compressor will barely generate any compressed air, too much heat and the compressor will overheat and breakdown, requiring manual repairs with $(l:components/solar_cell)Solar Cells/$.
$(item)太阳能压缩机/$在产生压缩空气的同时，也会按产气量成比例地产生热量。若想让$(item)太阳能压缩机/$发挥全部潜力，就必须妥善管理热量：热量过低，压缩机几乎不会产生压缩空气；热量过高，压缩机会过热并损坏，需要使用$(l:components/solar_cell)太阳能元件/$手动修理。

$(l:machines/heat_sink)Heat Sinks/$, $(l:machines/heat_pipe)Heat Pipes/$, and $(l:tubes/air_grate_module)Air Grates Modules/$ are the best tools to manage and remove the heat generated by the $(item)Solar Compressor/$. $(l:machines/vortex_tube)Vortex Tubes/$ are also useful for heat management, as they can be used to generate additional heat to reach max efficiency. With the right setup, even $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)max speed/$ $(item)Solar Compressors/$ can reach a heat equilibrium at max efficiency.

$(l:machines/heat_sink)散热片/$、$(l:machines/heat_pipe)热管/$和$(l:tubes/air_grate_module)空气格栅模块/$是管理并移除$(item)太阳能压缩机/$所产热量的最佳工具。$(l:machines/vortex_tube)涡流管/$对热量管理也很有用，因为它们可以用来产生额外热量，以达到最高效率。只要布局得当，即使是$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#speed)最高速度/$的$(item)太阳能压缩机/$，也能在最高效率下达到热平衡。

The compressor has built-in thermal padding that activates whenever it is unable to generate compressed air, preventing it from gaining or losing any heat while inactive.$(br2)The compressor reaches max efficiency at $(thing)350°C/$, and overheats at $(thing)425°C/$.
当压缩机无法产生压缩空气时，它内置的隔热层就会启动，使其在停机状态下既不会升温也不会降温。$(br2)压缩机在$(thing)350°C/$时达到最高效率，在$(thing)425°C/$时会过热。
